content: One of Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s strangest random encounters occurs when you’re offering taxi services, and a man with a beard wearing a dark suit and sunglasses climbs into the backseat with a gun. This can happen if you’re playing as either Jason or Lucia, but both scenes play out the same way: The man wants you to run a red light, ignore phone calls, and drive him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach. He also sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, with a calm but forceful demeanor that seems almost sociopathic. Several clips of the sequence have already hit the internet, and to many people, it’s an obvious nod to Collateral, Michael Mann’s 2004 thriller about a hitman who takes a cab driver hostage.
